purpose: Candidate control and analog placement for first integrated inverter PCB; root may adjust during courtyard and routing review.
coordinate_convention: KiCad footprint origin; rotation_deg uses pcbnew SetOrientationDegrees; all items F.Cu. Header origins are pad 1, not geometric centers.

J13.value: SWD: VTREF IO CLK GND NRST

J9.value: ENC_A: PWR GND A B Z

J10.value: ENC_B: PWR GND A B Z

J11.value: SPI_A: PWR GND SCK MOSI MISO CS

J12.value: SPI_B: PWR GND SCK MOSI MISO CS

notes: Keep U10/U11/U12 with RS1/RS2/RS3 respectively. Requested shunts are near x127/152/177,y74; the amplifiers sit below the power loop at y83. Differential Kelvin routes must be paired and return sense pin1 to the corresponding shunt LOW pad independently of load-current return.

Keep phase/high-side/driver switching copper out of the x98..120 analog corridor except the upper ends of voltage-divider chains. Route high-impedance divider nodes only within their local chain/filter/buffer cluster.

MCU rotated 180 degrees presents pins8..11 to the right, pins18/24..29 to the top. Put 1nF ADC shunt capacitors on the MCU side of the 100-ohm resistors; use continuous quiet reference plane, no split under these routes.

All HSE, CAN and sensor 5V DNP pieces retain reserved courtyards. Y1/C83/C84 occupy the MCU right-side HSE pads; ADC current RCs are farther right to avoid them. HSE provisional crystal still needs load-value validation before fitting.
VBIAS buffer is centered under the three current amplifiers. Keep its quiet 3.3V/GND return out of DC bus and braking current paths. No PHASE copper beneath current references or ADC inputs.
U6/R13/C17 are assigned to the control cluster; the power-placement table must omit them to avoid duplicate placement ownership.

J8/J9/J10/J11/J12/J13/J14/J15 use the existing 2.54mm one-row header candidate map; SW2 uses Button_Switch_THT:SW_PUSH_6mm. Anchor positions are footprint origins (pad1 for the headers), with courtyards checked against the local KiCad candidate files. This does not populate source schematic footprint fields.

Candidate positions intentionally favor readable functional groups and routing channels. Mechanical positions and local orientations may be iterated by root during board assembly; no schematic, BOM, footprint field or DNP state is changed by this JSON.

validation.method: Local footprint F.CrtYd polygons/rectangles bounded and transformed by actual footprint origin and pcbnew rotation; pads+0.25mm fallback if no courtyard. Count threshold >0.02mm overlap on each axis. Power-table cross-conflicts and routing DRC are delegated to root.
